from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Equity data extractable from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the report")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of equity attributable to parent company shareholders")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period this equity data covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="Snippet from report containing the equity figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[EquityRecord]
